scope: Independent verification of completed Prompt19-02 coordinator C work; no source fix, catalog regeneration, deployment or19-03 gameplay turn.
summaryKo: 새 catalog·API·seed/frontier 연결과 국토 coverage는 재검사를 통과했다. 그러나 원본 내부에 없는 face의 접촉 기반 fine 귀속, hole 보존 반례, 귀속 처리 설명의 누락이 확인되어19-02를 원본 기반 미세 경계 완료로 최종 승인할 수 없다.

regression.limit: Actual frontier tests manually update controller fixtures. They do not prove HTTP/authority/atomic turn commit or undo/redo on the new catalog.

http.execution: Read-only host-local API checks. Sandbox-local fetch initially failed; the authorized read-only host check succeeded. No game/start/turn route was invoked.

geometry.method: Current index and selected metadata, Korean exact geometry, adjacency and edge shard identities checked; no full5981-file/tile rehash. Fresh OGC/ring validity, boundary cancellation and Korea-incident edge reciprocity checks.
geometry.limit: Coverage and valid topology do not by themselves certify correct administrative provenance, source-hole meaning or the precision of source attribution.

findings.titleKo: 원본 내부 membership이 없는 영역을 fine 행정구역으로 확장 귀속
findings.mechanism: The joined generator enables reconcile by default. A zero-interior-membership face touching a single source feature is assigned that fine feature with unique-positive-length-source-contact. The resulting merged cell may keep administrative basis, ADM3/ADM2 and unresolvedFineSourceAssignment:false.
findings.impactKo: 영토·점령·전선은 동작할 수 있어도 실제 원본 행정구역 밖의 면적이 그 행정구역으로 취급된다. 실제 자료 기반 미세 경계라는 목표와 source attribution을 별도로 검증해야 한다. 모두 machine-epsilon 틈은 아니다.
findings.suggestedFixKo: 원본 포함 근거가 없는 면적은 미확정/coarse provenance로 구분하거나 추가 원본으로 귀속 근거를 확보한다. 접촉 추론을 사용할 정책이라면 추론 면적·경계·UI/lookup 의미를 명시하고 원본 내부 소속과 구분한다.
findings.notClaimed: Nearest-neighbor guessing or source coordinate snapping was not found in this path. It is a recorded contact-based inference, but is still different from original interior membership.

findings.titleKo: 유일 접촉 귀속이 원본 hole을 fine 영역으로 메울 수 있음

freshReproduction.method: In-memory arrangePrompt19Sources fixture, same default reconciliation and continueTerminals:false/preserveCanonicalResiduals:true as production path.
freshReproduction.input: Fixed envelope and coarse parent box[0,0,4,4]; sole ADM3 source has same exterior and square hole[1,1,3,3].

findings.impactKo: 원본이 덮지 않는 hole을 같은 fine 행정구역에 넣으면서 source geometry 보존·hole 보존을 통과한 것처럼 해석할 여지가 있다. 현재 실제 데이터의 모든1287face가 hole이라는 뜻은 아니며, 그 분류는 추가 확인이 필요하다.
findings.suggestedFixKo: 한 source에 접한 zero-member hole/coast/enclave를 구분하고, 원본이 실제 포함하지 않는 face에 fine identity를 자동 부여하지 않는 회귀 검사를 추가한다.

findings.titleKo: C 결과 설명과 fine/coarse 처리 범위가 충분히 일치하지 않음
findings.evidence: Report explains207/48 explicitly coarse residual cells but does not quantify the separate841/446 contact-assigned faces included in fine cells. The two mechanisms must not be conflated.

explicitCoarse.runtimeMeaning: These255 regions are ordinary occupiable territories, not diagnostic-only polygons.

findings.suggestedFixKo: 실제 원본 포함·접촉 추론 귀속·coarse 미확정 영역을 각각 집계하고 원본 시점/행정수준과 함께 보고·표시한다. fineAssignmentComplete:false만으로 모든 추론을 설명하지 않는다.

limits: Existing per-zoom rendered-area report was reviewed but the full tile scan was not repeated. Its step8 scanlines, interval-midpoint coast tolerance and no extraArea rejection do not prove every subpixel gap/overlap or country label assignment.
Current fixture suites do not include the freshly reproduced single-source-hole case.
No new production build or browser gameplay/turn/undo/redo was run in this independent audit. C's previous build/UI observations remain prior evidence;19-03 remains pending.
Session/version isolation is restart/HMR based; a live pointer-only hot swap is not verified.
KOR2018 ADM3 and PRK2019/2013 source timing limitations remain. Exact2020 administrative reconstruction is not certified.

Source-contact inference policy is distinguished from implementation corruption. General permission to repair/integrate was found in C's user request; no explicit discussion accepting this specific attribution policy was found. This report does not introduce a separate permission gate.
nextStepKo: C에서 source-contact 귀속과 hole 처리·provenance를 보완하고 작은 반례+양국 실제 자료를 재검증한다. 국토 coverage와 runtime 연결을 유지하면서 새 catalog를 갱신한 뒤19-03 실제 양방향 턴·전선·undo/redo·성능을 확인한다.
